title: Audify
tagline: Audify is a cast action that converts any text into a song onchain using decentralized compute
description: Audify converts any text into a song onchain using decentralized compute.  This is achieved by the power of coophive compute system. Casts from farcaster are converted into music and would be ninted as NFT with royalty attached to them enabling creators earn on future sales of the NFT.
how_its_made: It was to be built leveraging Next and Frog receipe package which would be used in building the farcaster frames. The backend was to be built with Golang while the smartcontract and market place were meant to be built with thirdweb, react js, typescript, solidity , Hardhat and tailwindcss.
